name: Dynamic Product Tabs Builder for WooCommerce
author: Riaan K.

sections.description:
This plugin helps you present product information clearly and consistently. You can create tabs that appear across many products, add tabs only to specific products, and decide exactly which tabs should be shown and in which order. Everything is managed from familiar WooCommerce screens.

You’re not limited to text. Tab content supports your usual WordPress tools, so shortcodes and embedded content work as expected. If you prefer a compact layout, you can switch from tabs to an accordion with a single option. Icons are supported too, using both WordPress’ Dashicons and a bundled copy of Font Awesome, so your tab headings can be visual and easy to scan.

Unlike many paid alternatives, the features you’d expect from a “pro” plugin are included here. You can target tabs by product category, tag, or brand. You can override a global tab’s content for a single product when it needs a special note. You can also hide a specific global tab on a particular product without affecting the rest of your catalog. And when it’s time to tidy things up, a simple “Reorder” screen lets you arrange everything exactly how you want it to appear on the product page.

This plugin is built to play nicely with WooCommerce. It declares compatibility with WooCommerce High Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Cart & Checkout Blocks, is translation‑ready, and supports WooCommerce Brands when that taxonomy is available.

How it works

Create the tabs you want to reuse by going to Products → Product Tabs. Give each tab a title, add the content, and pick an icon if you want. If you assign categories, tags, or brands to a tab, it will only appear on products that match those terms. If you don’t assign anything, the tab can be shown on all products.

When you’re editing an individual product, you’ll see two places to work with tabs. First, there’s a simple “Product Tabs” area where you can add one‑off tabs that apply only to that product. Second, there’s a “Product Tabs” section in the Product Data panel where you can choose to use your global tabs as‑is, hide a global tab for this product, or replace its content just for this product while keeping the original title and icon.

To get the order just right, open Products → Product Tabs and switch to the Reorder tab. There, you can drag to arrange the default WooCommerce tabs and your global tabs together in one list. Per‑product tabs appear after this sequence, in the order you set on the product itself.

If you prefer accordions instead of tabs—especially on mobile—turn on “Show as accordion” in the settings. The plugin will keep your content and order, but present it in a collapsible format that’s often easier to scan on small screens.

For store admins who manage large catalogs, the Products list search is extended so that text inside custom product tabs can help you find the items you’re looking for.

What you can do

You can create tabs once and reuse them wherever they make sense, or keep things product‑specific when needed. Tabs can be targeted to categories, tags, or brands so the right information appears in the right place. When a single product needs something different, you can keep the global tab’s title and icon but change just the content for that product, or simply hide that tab on the product entirely.

You’re in control of the overall experience. Rename or hide WooCommerce’s default tabs, choose icons, and set the final order so every product page feels consistent. If you prefer a compact layout, switch to an accordion in one click. Content supports shortcodes and HTML, so your existing blocks and embeds continue to work without any adjustments.

Real‑world examples

A fashion store might add a “Size & Fit” tab to all apparel, while a leather goods category gets a “Care & Materials” tab with specific guidance. Electronics can carry a “Warranty” tab across the range, but a premium model can override that tab’s content to explain its extended coverage. Food and cosmetic products often need “Ingredients & Allergens,” and brands that you carry can have a “Brand Story” tab shown only on their products.

Policy information becomes easier to manage too. A “Shipping & Returns” tab can be targeted to categories that share the same rules, while unusual items can hide that tab or replace its content. If your products need manuals, installation videos, or FAQs, you can embed them with shortcodes so everything is neatly organized right where customers expect to find it.

Compatibility

This plugin works with WordPress 6.0 or newer and WooCommerce 6.0 or newer (tested up to 10.3.0). It is compatible with High Performance Order Storage (HPOS), declares compatibility with WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks, and supports WooCommerce Brands when the “product_brand” taxonomy is present.

Privacy

The plugin does not collect personal data. It stores only the settings and tab content you add within your WordPress site.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Install and activate “Dynamic Product Tabs Builder for WooCommerce.”
  3. Go to Products → Product Tabs to create your reusable tabs and, if needed, target them by category, tag, or brand.
  4. In the Settings tab, rename or hide default WooCommerce tabs, pick icons, and enable Accordion if you prefer that layout.
  5. In the Reorder tab, drag to set the final order of default and global tabs.
  6. When editing a product, add any product‑specific tabs and, if necessary, hide or override global tabs for that product.
  7. View a product on your site to confirm the result.
sections.faq:
Does it work with my theme?

Most themes that use WooCommerce’s standard product tabs will work right away. If your theme replaces the tab template entirely, the plugin’s changes may not appear, or you may need to disable the theme’s custom tab system.

Can I use shortcodes or blocks in tab content?

Yes. Content runs through WordPress’ content filters, so shortcodes, embeds, and most block output work as you’d expect.

How do I show a tab only on certain products?

Assign categories, tags, or brands to the tab when you create it. With no assignments, the tab can be shown on all products.

Can I override a global tab’s content for one product?

Yes. In the Product Data → Product Tabs section, uncheck “Use global settings,” enable “Override content” for that tab, and add the custom content. The title and icon stay as defined globally.

How do I hide a default WooCommerce tab like Reviews?

Open Products → Product Tabs → Settings and mark that tab as hidden.

How do I change the order of tabs?

Use the Reorder tab to arrange default and global tabs in one place. Per‑product tabs appear after this sequence, in the order you set on the product.

Does it support icons?

Yes. You can use Dashicons or the bundled Font Awesome classes. The admin includes a searchable icon picker to make selection easy.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce HPOS and Blocks?

Yes. Compatibility with WooCommerce High Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Cart & Checkout Blocks is declared. The plugin focuses on single product pages and won’t interfere with cart or checkout.

Does it add scripts on the front end?

A lightweight script and stylesheet are loaded to support icons and the optional accordion layout. Dashicons and Font Awesome are enqueued only when needed.

Is it translation‑ready?

Yes. The plugin is fully internationalized with a text domain.
